segments.speaker: Principal Rao
segments.text: The annual day is on the fifteenth of December.

segments.speaker: Mrs. Iyer
segments.text: I think we should move it to a weekend so more parents can come.

segments.speaker: Mr. Das
segments.text: That depends on whether the auditorium is free on Saturday.

segments.text: Right. If the auditorium is free, we'll move it to Saturday the fourteenth.

segments.text: I can check with the auditorium manager tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Principal Rao
segments.text: Please do, and let us know by Friday.
